setlist_extra.title: Lucy In The Sky With Diamond

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lucy in the Sky With Diamonds** (2 reviews): Listener found the song great in person but painful to listen to on tape; Jerry nailed about 50% of the lyrics for this second set opener, sounding in need of a break [6][9]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Jerry sounds strong in the opening, though he flubs a little here and there; Post-Terrapin jam is described as some of the finest, solid, and mature stuff of the 90s [10][16]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Sugaree, Minglewood, and Terrapin are highlighted as good moments in the recording [13]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy stands out very nicely in this monitor SBD version of the show [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-07-23.166961.sbd.miller.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1994-07-23.sbd.burns.14853.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 162 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [2]
- **gd1994-07-23.147691.schoepsCMC5MK4.ebel.flac1648**: source not stated; 17 songs; 165 min [3]
- **gd94-07-23.sbd.fishman.14839.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 152 min; rated 3.59/5 by 17 [5]. Said about its sound: Recording is not too hissy; Garcia's guitar sounds bright and sparkly with piezo pickup blended [8]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalled the floor at Soldier Field as the dancing spot and getting tickets from previous shows [7]
- Listener wished Jerry would rest, stop smoking, and play in the ocean to get healthy [12]
- Jerry sounded and looked old like Father Time, but the audience went anyway and enjoyed it [13]
- Arriving late, the group missed the opener and heard Sugaree while rushing to their seats [17]
- They were told the opener was Sugar Mag, but it was actually Picasso Moon, causing frustration [17]
- Reviewer described the performance as uninspired, suggesting energy was left at Deer Creek [6]
- Reviewer argues the show is great despite uninspiring line-up, unlike common negative ratings [10]
- Traffic was enjoyed more this night than on the 24th, though Jerry's voice signaled the end [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-07-23.166961.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 11, 2023; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) > DAT Clone > AIFF [1]
- **gd1994-07-23.sbd.burns.14853.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Ryan Burns; source: SBD Monitor Mix > DAT @ 48k [2]. Also: Missing SBD encore was patched with FOB Schoeps microphone recorded to DAT [2]
- **gd1994-07-23.147691.schoepsCMC5MK4.ebel.flac1648**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB Schoeps CMC5 Mk 4-> Aerco P/S-> Panasonic SV255-> DAT Location Sec B, Row 22, seat 30 [3]. Also: Transfer from DAT to WAV at 48k; Set 1 shares characteristics with Shn ID 000574 [3]
- **gd94-07-23.sbd.fishman.14839.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD>D>CD>SHN Transcription from DAT and Encoding by JR Fishman [5]
